subjects: Fictional adults; intentionally unretouched-looking synthetic demo photographs.

Deliberately awkward candid composition, slightly tilted frame, point-and-shoot frontal flash, real pores, uneven shadows, a little high-ISO grain and background motion softness, spontaneous funny photo someone would send to a group chat. Clothing normal and fully clothed.
